Participants, procedure and measures
Anonymous participants in separate rooms played a single allocation game. In ultimatum, the recipient can accept or reject; in dictator, the recipient cannot veto. Each game was administered with and without decision-dependent payment.

result
Result
Paid ultimatum and dictator offers differed, consistent with considerations beyond fairness alone. The paid results were replicable across waves, unlike the no-pay ultimatum result.
